## How to Run

```bash
# no asset fetch is required; current max uses its declared systems-only micro-shard

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile pro
```
